# Beste UI

> Production-ready shadcn/ui blocks, pages, pieces and components for React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Install any of them with the shadcn CLI, or let an AI agent search and install them over MCP. Most of the catalog is free; a one-time Pro license unlocks the rest.

Beste UI is made by [beste.co](https://beste.co), an opinionated block-based site builder. This site is the component catalog. Canonical host: https://ui.beste.co. Every page is also readable as Markdown: add `.md` to any address or send `Accept: text/markdown`. The long-form version of this file is https://ui.beste.co/llms-full.txt.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://ui.beste.co/docs): What Beste UI is, the two primitive flavors, how you install, what is free and what is Pro.
- [Installation](https://ui.beste.co/docs/installation): Initialise shadcn/ui, install a block by URL or by `@beste-ui/name`, unlock Pro with an email and license key.
- [shadcn CLI reference](https://ui.beste.co/docs/cli): init, add and build, and the predictable registry URLs behind every asset.
- [Theming](https://ui.beste.co/docs/theming): CSS variables, the background/foreground convention, dark mode, radius and tones.
- [MCP server](https://ui.beste.co/docs/mcp): Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf or VS Code to https://ui.beste.co/api/mcp and search, compose and install in plain language.
- [Pricing and Pro](https://ui.beste.co/docs/pricing): Why Pro exists, what the license covers, the student discount, how to request an asset.
- [Pricing](https://ui.beste.co/pricing): Plans and checkout.
- [License](https://ui.beste.co/license): The full license text.
- [Changelog](https://ui.beste.co/changelog): Every release, newest first.
- [Blog](https://ui.beste.co/blog): Long-form posts on shadcn, theming, forms, MCP and the catalog.

## Catalog

- [Blocks](https://ui.beste.co/blocks): 168 full page sections in 41 categories. 168 are free, the rest are Pro.
- [Pages](https://ui.beste.co/pages): 0 whole pages composed from the blocks. One command installs a page and every block inside it.
- [Pieces](https://ui.beste.co/pieces): 1,076 small widgets in 45 categories that drop into the media slots of a block. Free.
- [Components](https://ui.beste.co/components): 157 styled primitives in 8 categories: buttons, badges, cards, text effects, inspector controls. Free.
- [Search](https://ui.beste.co/search): Search every tier by name or by describing what you need.

## Block categories

- [Feature](https://ui.beste.co/blocks/feature): 31 blocks. Highlight your product features with stunning layouts.

## Collections

Sets of blocks that share one design language, so a whole site reads as one piece.

- [Altair](https://ui.beste.co/blocks/collection/altair): 8 blocks. Full-height photography that drifts under the page, serif headlines that settle in word by word, soft light and film grain, and gently rounded pills. Calm, fluid pages for practices built on care.
- [Auralis](https://ui.beste.co/blocks/collection/auralis): 12 blocks. Oversized display type on monochrome surfaces, with a monospace parenthetical eyebrow and a pill CTA that carries its own seal. Editorial layouts for studio, agency and portfolio sites.
- [Polaris](https://ui.beste.co/blocks/collection/polaris): 5 blocks. A square accent eyebrow over bold uppercase labels, hairline rules under every section header, and a two-tone seal button. Structured, high-contrast layouts for creative studios.
- [Sirius](https://ui.beste.co/blocks/collection/sirius): 27 blocks. Light-weight display headings on white, a single accent colour, and media tiles that float a live piece of product UI. Calm, spacious pages for a modern SaaS.

## For agents

- [MCP endpoint](https://ui.beste.co/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP. Tools: search_blocks, get_block, get_block_source, list_categories, list_collections, install_block, compose_page. No key needed except for Pro sources.
- [Registry index](https://ui.beste.co/r/registry.json): Every block as a shadcn registry item. Base UI flavor at https://ui.beste.co/r-base/registry.json.
- [Markdown](https://ui.beste.co/index.md): This site as Markdown, one page at a time.
- [Full guide](https://ui.beste.co/llms-full.txt): Installation, pricing, MCP and the catalog in detail.
